title: Shark Tank Investor Kevin O'Leary Dumped AAPL immediately after Apple announced they would no longer Report Unit Sales

organizations.name: shark tank investor kevin o'leary dumped aapl

text: Shark Tank Investor Kevin O'Leary Dumped AAPL immediately after Apple announced they would no longer Report Unit Sales By Jack Purcher Nov 6, 2018, 7:35 am 286 pts Kevin O'Leary, chairman of O'Shares ETFs and an investor on "Shark Tank," told CNBC on Monday he dumped Apple stock within "seconds" of the tech giant's announcement last week that it would stop revealing device unit sales.
